findings.issue: Each bytes part of abi.encodePacked is copied by solc 0.4's word loop 'while idx >= 32' followed by a masked merge of the last partial word, printed as a while plus an unreadable mask expression instead of one copy line per part (P7).
findings.rule: 'while n >= 32: mem[t] = mem[s]; s += 32; t += 32; n -= 32' followed by 'mem[t'] = (mem[t'] & (256**(32 - r) - 1)) | (mem[s'] & ~(256**(32 - r) - 1))' with r = n % 32 copies exactly n bytes: print mem[t0 len n0] = mem[s0 len n0] (the bytes after t0 + n0 in the last word are kept).

notes: All 72 ABI functions reviewed (getters and setters read; relayTokens, payInterest, the interest functions and both executeSignatures by structure). Live source loops: hasEnoughValidSignatures' signature loop ('while idx < _9', 1596/2119) and addressArrayContains (1625/2148). uintToString's two while loops (Message.sol:148/154) are only reached by hashMessage's AMB branch, and every call here passes isAMBMessage = false, so they are rightly absent (not counted). Implicit loops: 30 solc 0.4 word-copy loops 'while idx >= 32' (first finding) and 11 ABI encoding copies 'while idx < 32 * _N' (P7). hashMessage's non-AMB branch is exact ('104'/'124' prefixes at 1520-1526). P4: mapping keys of the form concat(Bytes(12, 0), ...).
summary: Faithful, with both live loops found; readability suffers from solc 0.4's encodePacked word-copy loops and partial-word masks, which should be single copy lines.
